unstuck_said.text: Opened first issue Febchuk/tool-forge#1 as dhyabi2 (2026-10-03): proposed an additive second mint path beside Stripe - buyer pays XNO to sellers published Nano account, Worker treats confirmed receive (public Nano RPC account_info) as the paid precondition that mints the same bearer token; block hash = receipt + meter event, no prepaid balance or meter to reconcile. Framed in ToolForge own 402/prepaid-token architecture, release-on-faulty-upstream mapped to not claiming a receivable. Open-research disclosure included. See https://github.com/Febchuk/tool-forge/issues/1
